scenarios.name: Inspect the context menu for a sketch under an extrusion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with an extrusion and its underlying dimensioned sketch
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the sketch child in the browser
a context menu opens beside the sketch row
the menu offers Edit Sketch, Redefine, Share Sketch and Properties
it offers Measure, Visibility and Export Sketch As
the sketch geometry and dimensions are highlighted over the solid
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the sketch row, geometry and dimensions remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the sketch row is no longer highlighted
the highlighted sketch geometry and dimensions disappear from the viewport
